newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P cuts Nomura Sec outlook to negative.
newsitem.headline: S&P cuts Nomura Sec outlook to negative.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Monday it had changed its outlook for Nomura Securities Co Ltd and Nomura's units to negative from stable but affirmed the credit ratings of Nomura and Nomura's units.

S&P said in a statement that the change reflects the credit rating agency's concerns that Nomura's business franchise over the medium term could be seriously impaired by a recent scandal in which Nomura made illicit payments to a client. Media reports said the client was linked to a former "sokaiya" racketeer.
"The fallout already has resulted in the suspension of orders by several large-scale Nomura clients and the resignation of senior managers, including the president," S&P said.
S&P said it will also assess the effects from any actions taken by Japan's securities watchdog, the Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission, and by other regulatory authorities.

Companies affected by the outlook change were Nomura Securities, Nomura Holding America Inc, Nomura International Plc, Nomura Option International Plc, Nomura Bank International Plc, Nomura Europe Finance NV and Nomura Trust and Banking Co Ltd.
